witness.branch: Road route over a signposted elevated structure
witness.quote: when such structure is signposted as provided in this section
witness.reason: The broad road layout can contain an elevated highway segment governed by the fixed speed-limit sign.
required_context: Construct a road route crossing an identifiable bridge or elevated structure without changing the travel task.
Establish highway dedication and public vehicular availability.
Establish highway status, structure identity and endpoints, driving person and covered vehicle.
Establish the sign's actual instruction, placement, authority and governed road portion, including signs 100 feet before both structure ends.
Identify the conventional motor vehicle and person driving.
Preserve the supplied unresolved chapter 408, chapters 484A to 484E, vehicle-definition and autonomous-definition references.
Record vehicle speed and structure occupancy without adding a deceleration deadline.
Retain chapter 408 authority, local-authority request or Department initiative, investigation, finding, otherwise permissible speed and resulting declaration as separate administrative facts.
Specify signs stating that maximum 100 feet before each end, governing approaches, erection and maintenance, and Department authorization.
Supply declared structural maximum and provenance; retain administrative activation conditions separately.
Supply the declared structural maximum, units and provenance; do not infer structural capacity from an ordinary speed-limit sign.
witness.subject_reason: The available motor-vehicle driver can drive a covered vehicle over the qualifying structure.
